comment: Corpus for the tokenizer parity test (spec section 7).
Used by BOTH sides of the parity test: inference-app/src/bin/tokenize.rs (GGUF / llama.cpp) and frontend/scripts/parity.mjs (@huggingface/transformers).
Rules under test (spec 4.1): tokenize only the input, add no BOS/EOS, no dummy-prefix space, and parse special-token strings as single tokens.
Keep each case on its own line, with a short comment above it.
Note: `<end_of_turn>` from the spec's example is NOT a special token of THIS Gemma tokenizer — both sides must treat it as ordinary text.
This model's special tokens are `<bos>`, `<eos>`, `<pad>`, `<|turn>`, `<turn|>`, `<|think|>` and friends.
